The category screen's title "Knowledge Quiz" is English only. Should it be in Polish on a Polish device?

The title comes from the content data (src/content/app.json) and has one language only. The story's first criterion and TC-02-10 ask for every text on the category screen to be Polish on a Polish device. Everything else on the screen already switches; the category labels 3+, 4+, 5+ are the same in both languages. The constitution says a change to the content data schema needs Maciej's approval.

a) Title in both languages: "Quiz wiedzy" / "Knowledge Quiz" — The content data's title gets a Polish and an English value and follows the switch. This changes the content data schema, and the foundation test TC-00-03 then reads the title in the app's language. The Polish name is my suggestion; you can give another. (recommended)
b) Keep "Knowledge Quiz" as the app's name in both languages — Nothing changes in the content data. The title is treated as a name, like 3+. On a Polish device the screen keeps one English phrase, which narrows "every text" in the first criterion.

Why a: The criterion and TC-02-10 say every text on the screen is Polish. A title that stays English is the first thing a reviewer or the client would notice. The schema change is small: one field with two values.

raw:
US-02-03 is parked on one critical decision, DEC-61: whether the title on the category screen should be translated. The rest of the story is built and committed as WIP 473757d on feature/US-02-03. Unit tests and gates pass. The new Maestro flows are written but have not run on the emulator.

**What is built**
- **The switch:** a "Polski | English" row under the title on the category screen. The active half is shown inverted (white on black).
- **Language behaviour:** the choice is saved under the key `language` through `src/storage.ts`. If nothing is saved, or the saved value is not `pl`/`en`, the app uses the device language. Cards, the end card and the return control all follow the chosen language.
- **Decks:** switching leaves every deck's order and position unchanged.
- **Tests:** new flows TC-02-10 to TC-02-13. TC-03-05 now uses the switch as its test case is written. `scripts/test-acceptance.sh` runs TC-02-11 with the device set to German instead of the English TC-03-05 run.
- **Changed tests from US-02-01:** I wrapped the screen in `LanguageProvider` in three of its derived unit tests (AC-02-01-3, -4, -5). Their assertions are unchanged.

**What the resumed run must do**
- Apply the owner's answer to the title.
- Add a title assertion to flows TC-02-10, TC-02-11 and TC-02-12.
- Fill in DEC-61 with the owner's answer and finalise its status.
- Run the whole acceptance suite on the final head.

US-02-02 (PR #15) also adds a "continue" entry to `src/app/index.tsx`, so expect a merge conflict there.
